Nioh 3 Builds: Split-Glaive Arcanist (Switch Glaive and Splitstaff Build)
In this Nioh 3 build guide, we're going to be taking a look at my personal first playthrough. Build the Split-Glaive Arcanist using a combination of the Switch Glaive and Splitstaff to shred two enemies with fast paced attacks, combos, and heavy hitting magic spells and Soul Core to have. 
As this is a full playthrough build, I'll be telling you exactly what you should be looking out for, both in the early game and late game in order to continue using this build as you make your way through the game.
